Container settings deviate from hardening baseline [d3d0a820]

checks.title: Package has an SSP, Assessment Results and a POA&M
checks.description: An authorization package needs all three core documents for the AO to weigh risk.

checks.title: Required SSP sections are present
checks.description: System characteristics, categorization, boundary, architecture, data flow, components, inventory, users and control implementation must all be filled in.

issues.message: Missing or empty: Data flow (system-characteristics/data-flow/description).

checks.title: Security categorization is consistent (FIPS 199 high-water mark)
checks.description: Each C/I/A impact must be at least the highest impact of the system's information types, and the overall sensitivity level must equal the highest of C, I and A.

issues.message: Confidentiality is categorized low but an information type is moderate; FIPS 199 requires the high-water mark.

checks.title: Key roles are assigned to people
checks.description: System Owner, Authorizing Official and ISSO each need a named party in metadata responsible-parties.

issues.message: No party is assigned the Authorizing Official role.

checks.title: No draft or placeholder language
checks.description: Text such as TBD, TODO, '[insert ...]' or 'review and refine' means the SSP is still a draft.

issues.message: Contains draft language: 'TBD'.

checks.title: Every baseline control has an implementation statement
checks.description: Each control in the selected baseline must appear in the SSP's implemented-requirements.

issues.message: Baseline control is not addressed in the SSP.

checks.title: Implemented requirements describe how the control is met
checks.description: Each implemented-requirement needs narrative text (by-components description, statement narrative or remarks) explaining the implementation. Not-applicable controls are covered by CTRL-006 instead.

issues.message: No implementation narrative.

checks.title: Implementation status is present, valid and consistent
checks.description: Each control needs an implementation status (implemented, partial, planned, alternative, not-applicable), and the control-level and component-level statuses must agree.

issues.message: Inconsistent status: marked implemented but a component is partial.

checks.title: SSP status agrees with the assessment
checks.description: A control the SSP calls 'implemented' should not have a not-satisfied finding, and a control assessed as satisfied should not still be 'planned' in the SSP.

issues.message: SSP says implemented, but the assessment found it not satisfied ('IA-5 Authenticator Management').
SSP says implemented, but the assessment found it not satisfied ('SI-2 Flaw Remediation').

checks.title: Planned and partial controls are tracked on the POA&M
checks.description: A control the SSP says is only planned or partially implemented is a known gap, so it should have a POA&M item.

issues.message: SSP status is planned but no open POA&M item covers it.

checks.title: Not-applicable controls are justified
checks.description: A control marked not-applicable needs text explaining why.

issues.message: Marked not-applicable with no justification.

checks.title: Assessment Results contain results and findings
checks.description: Each Assessment Results document needs at least one result with findings.

checks.title: Every in-scope control was assessed
checks.description: Each baseline control (or each SSP control when no baseline is given) should have a finding or be listed in the assessment's reviewed controls.

issues.message: No assessment finding for this baseline control.

checks.title: Assessment is current
checks.description: The most recent assessment result should fall within the allowed age (default 365 days).

issues.message: Latest assessment ended 2025-08-29, 445 days before 2026-11-17 (limit 365).

checks.title: Every not-satisfied finding has a POA&M item
checks.description: Each weakness the assessment found must be tracked on the POA&M (or the AO must be told why not).

issues.message: Not-satisfied finding 'CM-8 System Component Inventory' has no POA&M item.
Not-satisfied finding 'IA-5 Authenticator Management' has no POA&M item.

checks.title: Every POA&M item traces to an assessment finding
checks.description: Each open POA&M item should link (by UUID or control) to a not-satisfied finding in the Assessment Results, so the AO can see where the weakness came from.

issues.message: No not-satisfied finding in the Assessment Results for PL-2.
issues.ref: Legacy finding carried from a prior audit [4928980d]

checks.title: POA&M items have a scheduled completion date
checks.description: Every item that is not closed needs a due date (risk deadline or scheduled-completion-date).

issues.message: No scheduled completion date.

checks.title: Open POA&M items have dated milestones
checks.description: Each open item needs at least one milestone, and each milestone needs a date.

issues.message: No milestones.
issues.ref: Container settings deviate from hardening baseline [d3d0a820]

checks.title: POA&M items have a point of contact
checks.description: Someone must own each item: a point-of-contact prop, an origin party, or a task responsible party.

issues.message: No point of contact.

checks.title: No overdue POA&M items
checks.description: An open item past its due date needs a new date with a documented reason, or closure. This is a package problem (the POA&M is not being maintained). Overdue Critical/High items are raised to critical.

issues.message: Due 2026-10-01, 47 days overdue as of 2026-11-17.

checks.title: POA&M items record a severity
checks.description: Without a severity (Critical/High/Moderate/Low or CAT I/II/III) the item can't be prioritized.

issues.message: No recognizable severity.
issues.ref: Legacy finding carried from a prior audit [4928980d]

checks.title: Milestones fall on or before the item's due date
checks.description: A milestone scheduled after the completion date means the plan and the due date disagree.

issues.message: 1 milestone(s) after the due date 2027-01-31.
issues.ref: Legacy finding carried from a prior audit [4928980d]

checks.title: All UUID references resolve
checks.description: Every finding-uuid, risk-uuid, observation-uuid, component-uuid, party-uuid and '#uuid' link must point at an object in the same document or another document in the package.

issues.message: risk-uuid does not resolve to any object in the package (at poam-items/related-risks/risk-uuid).

checks.title: Assessed subjects are described in the SSP
checks.description: Observation subjects (components, inventory items) in the Assessment Results should match objects in the SSP. A miss can mean the assessment covered something outside the documented boundary, or that the two tools use different IDs.

issues.message: Subject 'fee3bfb0-cd1f-53a6-aa19-9f59da269576' (component) is not in the SSP.

checks.title: POA&M identifies the same system as the SSP
checks.description: The POA&M system-id should match one of the SSP's system-ids.

issues.message: POA&M system-id 42294d76-2b8a-52d3-98af-8bdaf0a8c01e is not one of the SSP's system-ids.

checks.title: UUIDs are unique within each document
checks.description: OSCAL requires each object's UUID to be unique in its document; duplicates make references ambiguous.

issues.message: UUID used 2 times.

checks.title: OSCAL versions are declared and consistent
checks.description: Each document should declare metadata/oscal-version, and the package should use one OSCAL version.

issues.message: Mixed OSCAL versions: assessment-results.json=1.1.2, poam.json=1.1.1, ssp.json=1.1.2.

checks.title: Documents are valid against the NIST OSCAL schemas
checks.description: Each document must validate against NIST's OSCAL JSON Schema for its model, or tools that import the package (eMASS, FedRAMP automation, GRC platforms) may reject it.

checks.title: Open Critical, High or CAT I weaknesses
checks.description: Lists each open Critical, High or CAT I item for the AO. This is risk, not a package defect, so it does not affect the readiness score or level; open Critical items are critical issues and High/CAT I items are high issues for the --fail-on gate.

issues.message: Open High / CAT I weakness (AC-2).
Open High / CAT I weakness (SI-2).

checks.title: Accepted risks are listed for the AO
checks.description: Items with an approved deviation (risk acceptance) are listed so the AO sees every risk that is being carried rather than fixed. Informational; does not affect the score or level.

issues.message: Risk accepted (Low / CAT III, AU-6).
